name: Kafta w Batata (Baked Kafta, Potatoes and Tomato)

components.name: Kafta w Batata
steps: Preheat oven to 195 C. Mix minced beef with grated onion, parsley, seven-spice, cinnamon, salt and pepper until cohesive, without overworking.
Oil a medium baking dish and flatten the kafta mixture into one even layer or form medium flattened patties.
Arrange thin potato slices, sliced tomato and the additional onion over and around the meat.
Whisk passata, tomato paste, measured water and remaining seasonings; pour over the layers, leaving tops partially exposed.
Cover tightly with foil and bake about 40 minutes. Remove foil and cook another 20-25 minutes until potatoes are completely tender and beef is cooked to 71 C throughout.
Rest 10 minutes, divide into four portions and spoon cooking sauce over each serving.
